title: Declared languages are read from config.json with jq in five places, because no verb prints them
body:
## What

Five places read a project's declared languages straight out of `intent/.config/config.json` with `jq -r '(.languages // []) | .[]'`:

- the commit gate, `lib/templates/hooks/pre-commit.sh:497`
- `intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-session/SKILL.md:43`
- `intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-review/SKILL.md:41`
- `intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-tca-audit/SKILL.md:59`
- `intent/plugins/claude/subagents/critic-prose/agent.md:33`

The binary parses the same field (`Config.languages`, `native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/project.rs:690`), but no verb prints a project's declared languages. `intent lang list` prints the packs a project may declare, `intent lang show <lang>` describes one pack, and `intent info` does not show them. So every reader that needs the list carries its own copy of the read, and each copy works only when the working directory is the project root.

## Expected

A read verb that prints the declared languages from `Config.languages`, through the project's own discovery, in a form a script can read. The gate and the four skill and agent files then call it instead of reading the file. The verb is ic's surface, so ic proposes its shape before any lane takes the rest.

Found by cc's sweep for second copies of the binary's project checks, on hv's question of 2026-10-22. No lane yet.

## Spec (vc, 2026-10-23, ruling on ic's surface note, refs/bank/ic/0616-0618/surface-note.md, blob 13571783fc26)

LANE: cc builds; ic's note is the shape. SHAPE: `intent lang declared`, in the `lang` family beside `lang list`, `lang init` and `lang remove`, so the family that writes `Config.languages` is the one that reads it: no args, no flags, no `--json`; reads `Config.languages` through project discovery from the cwd upward, never a cwd-relative config.json; prints each declared language on its own line in config order and nothing else; an empty declaration prints nothing at rc 0, because `languages: []` is a legitimate state (decision 62(1)); refusals are discovery's own (NotFound, Config), rc 1; a declared name outside the catalogue is printed, not refused, since `lang init` refuses it at the door and the gate's fail-open arm and `intent critic` already name it. Register row: read, `exposed_on_mcp: false`. CONSUMERS, in the templates bank: pre-commit.sh's languages read (:490-501; its jq-not-installed branch for languages goes), in-session SKILL.md:43, in-review SKILL.md:41, in-tca-audit SKILL.md:59 and critic-prose agent.md:33, each replaced by the verb with no jq fallback and no shim. PROOF: CLI arms: from a subdirectory the verb prints the config's languages in order; `languages: []` prints nothing at rc 0; outside a project rc 1 with discovery's remedy; and an arm over lib/templates and intent/plugins asserting that no jq read of `.languages` remains. ORDER: one Rust bank for 0616, 0617 and 0618 (dispatch rows, facade reads, renders, arms); `bin/devbin build all` (the verbs reach the pair only then, while templates are live on save); one templates bank in a detached worktree (decision 30); `intent claude skills sync`. CLOSES WHEN: the templates bank lands after the build and `intent issues close 0618` names the sha; the three close together.
